attacks.reason: The internal ribbing may not provide sufficient mechanical interlock to counteract cyclic masticatory forces.
attacks.evidence_required: Finite element analysis or experimental testing to validate the mechanical interlock of the internal ribbing.

attacks.reason: The transfer from 3D printing to mechanical interlock is not clearly justified.
attacks.evidence_required: A clear explanation of the relationship between 3D printing and mechanical interlock, or experimental evidence to support this claim.

attacks.reason: The inventive device fails under extreme cyclic masticatory forces, which may be encountered in certain patients.
attacks.evidence_required: Studies on the effects of extreme cyclic masticatory forces on the inventive device, or data from clinical trials on patients with high masticatory forces.

attacks.reason: The combination of 3D printing and internal ribbing is not a novel or unexpected combination, and may be considered obvious to experts in the field.
attacks.evidence_required: A clear explanation of why the combination of 3D printing and internal ribbing is not obvious, or evidence of prior art that demonstrates a similar combination.

attacks.reason: Similar devices with internal ribbing have been previously disclosed in the literature.
attacks.evidence_required: A thorough search of prior art to identify similar devices with internal ribbing, and a clear explanation of how the inventive device differs from these prior art devices.

attacks.reason: The 3D printing process may not be able to accurately replicate the complex geometric pattern of the internal ribbing.
attacks.evidence_required: Experimental evidence demonstrating the ability of 3D printing to accurately replicate the complex geometric pattern of the internal ribbing.

attacks.reason: It is difficult to design an experiment to test the effectiveness of the internal ribbing in reducing screw loosening.
attacks.evidence_required: A clear explanation of how to design an experiment to test the effectiveness of the internal ribbing, or evidence of a similar experiment that has been conducted in the past.

refinement_needed: A clear explanation of the relationship between 3D printing and mechanical interlock, and experimental evidence to support this claim, as well as a thorough search of prior art to identify similar devices with internal ribbing.
